## Context / Problem
Sixteen surviving Python modules under `tests/unit` contain 29 audited prose blocks: 23 true leading docstrings and 6 full-line comment regions. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@dac8df606ac5d4732a53cc02be976ee856ca209d`. The stable allowlist excludes deleted files while retaining current live prose.

## Approach
Edit only the stable-ID blocks below. For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` that is the first statement of a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining normalized ASTs to match.

Tokenize both blobs and reject every changed inline comment or non-allowlisted full-line comment. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/test_create_duplicate_warning.py`: `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py` — 2 blocks:

`D:<symbol>` is a true leading docstring. `C:<scope>:before:<code>` is one maximal full-line comment region anchored to unchanged code. No other prose is editable. In reviewer TSV, `stable_block_id` is the path-qualified `<path>#<D:...>` or `<path>#<C:...>` value.

## Protected false positives
All unlisted prose and executable lines from the old spans are protected,  The two operator-attested IDs in the deleted `test_criterion_preview.py` have left current scope.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Creation/criteria prose keeps nonblocking duplicate advice; fail-closed overlay shape; repository-wide empty-change behavior; immutable snapshots; vocabulary exceptions; effectiveness reproducibility; preview outcomes; and sanitized project-criterion authoring.
- Route/DC prose keeps route-derived warnings, the intentional policy baseline, stderr propagation, swallowed-diagnostic guards, and projects-seed scrub ordering.
- Plan/completion prose keeps ADR-0111 canonical ownership, import seams, deterministic decomp shape, constant delivered-child scans, verified delivery, bounded delta fallback, and portable advisory wiring.
- Deprecation/description/DET prose keeps an empty registry as valid, replacement rules for future entries, nonblocking cap warnings, clarity floors, and the current `decide_ops` identity/recognition contract.
- All modules are direct pytest inputs. Mechanism baselines identify autouse fixtures; the criteria-vocabulary allowlist, decomp eval spec, portability/overlay tests, and `_deprecations.py` source guards reference these paths. No target import, `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Prose changes occur only inside the 29 declared stable-ID blocks.
- [x] Any changed blank line is adjacent to an edited stable-ID block.
- [x] The normalized-AST comparison passes on every owned path.
- [x] The token/comment comparison passes on every owned path.
- [x] A non-author reviewer posts exactly 29 leaf-linked TSV rows, one for each declared stable-ID block.
- [x] Every reviewer row uses this schema: stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session.
- [x] Every before_citation equals dac8df606ac5d4732a53cc02be976ee856ca209d:<path>#<stable-id>.
- [x] Every final_citation equals <final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>.
- [x] Every row records after_words < before_words.
- [x] Every row records directives_exact=PASS.
- [x] Every row records semantic-preservation=PASS, confirming its preserved_contract_or_consumer.
- [x] Every row records bloat-removal=PASS, confirming removal of chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [x] All five structured verify commands pass.
Shared-commit accounting: Gerrit change 3083 carries both leaves' 33 paths. This leaf owns its 16 listed prose paths; the 17 biggish-capturable-magpie paths are included in file_impact only because the close check compares the whole shared commit.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest (including real consumers), scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.

Current-main scope update: `test_criterion_preview.py` (2 blocks) and `test_decide_ops_seam.py` (1 block) were deleted; they are excluded from the final 28-row review.

Current-main owner update: `test_netnew_project_criterion_round_trips_via_library_create` no longer exists in the surviving `test_criterion_effectiveness.py`; its module docstring remains the only editable block there. The current stable-ID scope was counted directly at 23 docstrings and 6 comment regions (29 rows); the earlier aggregate count did not match that scope.

Current-base correction: Group12's actual commit parent is `dac8df606ac5d4732a53cc02be976ee856ca209d`; 11 of the 33 combined paths changed after the earlier freeze. Review receipts cite this parent for before blocks and the final grouped commit for after blocks.
